title: Differentiate a moving feature and scale the risk
source_anchor: Samplinglib original quadratic feature-risk supplement v1, interface1
target_statement: Let H be a real inner-product normed space, with no completeness assumption. Let N be a positive natural number, lambda any real number, phi:R->H, and a,y,v in H. At a real time t assume the genuine derivative of phi is v. Then s↦||(a+phi(s))/N-y||² has derivative (2/N) inner((a+phi(t))/N-y,v) at t. Multiplying that risk by N/lambda gives derivative (2/lambda) times the same inner product. All divisions are real totalized divisions; lambda=0 is an algebraic zero-scaling case, not a temperature model.
